Do: Name the problem plainly and give a next step
Don't: Blame the user or use vague technical jargon
Example Copy: Something went wrong saving your file. Try again or contact support.
Avoid Copy: Error 503: upstream dependency failure. Please retry.

Do: Celebrate the first step and point forward
Example Copy: Welcome aboard - your first project is ready. Let's build something great.
Avoid Copy: Congratulations on registering. Please complete steps 1 through 7 below.

Do: Lead with the transformation the user gains
Example Copy: Ship faster. Break nothing. Sleep well.
Avoid Copy: Our platform offers CI/CD pipelines with 99.9% uptime SLAs.

Do: Use plain language and state obligations clearly
Don't: Add marketing spin or minimize importance
Example Copy: By continuing you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Avoid Copy: Just a quick heads-up about some legal stuff you probably know already!

Do: Acknowledge the frustration then solve it
Don't: Start with a scripted sorry-for-the-inconvenience opener
Example Copy: That sounds frustrating. Here is exactly what to do to fix it.
Avoid Copy: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you today.

Do: Mark the win without overstating it
Don't: Use hollow superlatives or excessive punctuation
Example Copy: Done. Your report is ready to download.
Avoid Copy: AMAZING!!! You just completed the workflow - you are a total rockstar!!!

Do: Show possibility and offer a clear first action
Don't: Leave the user stranded with a generic no-data message
Example Copy: No events yet. Create your first one and it will show up here.
Avoid Copy: There is nothing to display at this time.

Do: Anchor on the outcome the upgrade unlocks
Example Copy: Unlock team collaboration and ship reviews twice as fast.
Avoid Copy: Hurry - upgrade now before your trial expires in 24 hours!

Do: Describe what changed and why it matters to the user
Don't: Pad with buzzwords or bury breaking changes
Example Copy: Exports now run in the background so you can keep working while they finish.
Avoid Copy: We are excited to announce a paradigm-shifting update to our export subsystem.

Do: Share a genuine insight or moment with a light touch
Don't: Broadcast marketing copy as if it were conversation
Example Copy: Turns out the hardest part of a great demo is the 3 AM prep. Worth it.
Avoid Copy: Discover how our industry-leading solution drives ROI for teams like yours.

Do: Own the failure with facts and state the fix and timeline
Don't: Use passive voice or hedge with corporate non-apologies
Example Copy: We had an outage from 14:02 to 15:47 UTC. Here is what happened and what we changed.
Avoid Copy: Some users may have experienced service degradation due to unforeseen circumstances.

Do: Use a verb that names the exact outcome of the click
Don't: Use vague filler words like Submit or Click Here
